# Dezign Code

> Dezign Code is a premium yet affordable interior design company in Bangalore, specializing in customized home and office interiors, modular kitchens, wardrobes and full villa and apartment interior solutions, with 100% transparency, no hidden costs and on-time delivery.

## Key facts
- Address: Sampada, 183, 9th Main Rd, 7th Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102.
- Service areas: HSR Layout, Bangalore. Also serves Koramangala, Bellandur, Sarjapur Road, BTM Layout, Bommanahalli and Agara.
- Services: home and office interior design, full villa and apartment interiors, full-home interior design, modular kitchens, wardrobes and storage, living room and TV units, 2BHK and 3BHK interior packages, design consultation. Also sells new and antique furniture, artwork, decorator fabric and home accessories.
- Social: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/thedezigncode | Instagram https://www.instagram.com/dezign_code/ | YouTube https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoUUUQvqEz1cD1CDm_YMvZg | LinkedIn https://in.linkedin.com/company/the-dezign-code
- Typical full-home interior cost in Bangalore: roughly ₹6–12 lakh for a 2BHK and ₹10–20 lakh for a 3BHK, depending on scope, material grade and finish.
- Typical project duration: about 8 to 14 weeks from design sign-off to handover.
- Free consultation: book on WhatsApp at https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX?text=Hi%20Dezign%20Code%2C%20I%20would%20like%20to%20book%20a%20free%20interior%20design%20consultation.
